PreToolUse.command: bash -c 'if echo "$ANTIGRAVITY_TOOL_ARGS" | grep -q "original/"; then echo "ERROR: Access to original/ ground-truth directory is strictly forbidden." >&2; exit 2; fi'

PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$ANTIGRAVITY_TOOL_ARGS" | jq -r ".TargetFile // .FilePath // empty"); if [[ "$FILE" == deobfuscated/*/*.c ]]; then CAT=$( echo "$FILE" | cut -d/ -f2 ); NAME=$( basename "$FILE" .c ); clang-format -i "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; ./scripts/verify_target.sh "$CAT" "$NAME"; fi'
